about: Steven Piano's Disney section (M82): which songs are Disney's, besides those whose album Deezer says is on a Disney label. Each matcher is a rule; a song is Disney when one accepts it. names: the song's composer or artist holds one of these as words in a row (folded, punctuation dropped: 'Kristen Anderson-Lopez' is 'kristen anderson lopez'). artists: the composer or artist is exactly one of these (a film's name, as song files often give it). title: a case-insensitive regular expression found in the title as words (folded, punctuation dropped: 'You're Welcome' is 'you re welcome'). A matcher with names or artists and a title needs both; a title alone stands for any composer, so it must be a title no other well-known song has. Titles only: no lyrics, no music.
